slug: 2025-12-19 South Sudan orders full digitization of public institutions

systems.system: Presidential decree of 17 December 2025 granting the Electronic Services Council authority to digitise all government institutions
systems.owner: President Salva Kiir; Electronic Services Council
systems.tiers: all public institutions, to adopt digital systems by January 2026

systems.owner: Developed by the private service provider under contract with the Ministry of Information and Communications Technology and Postal Services
systems.tiers: guides the rollout of digital government initiatives; the article gives no adopting act, period or date

note: A decree to digitalise (directive) and a service-provider-authored e-government framework (government); no national strategy stated.
